TABLE.NAME: local_extsync_integration
TABLE.COMMENT: External integrations allowed to own objects in this site. One row per web service account: the integration is resolved from the authenticated user and is never supplied by the caller.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Web service account this integration acts as

FIELD.NAME: integrationkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Stable identifier of the integration, shown to administrators

TABLE.NAME: local_extsync_module
TABLE.COMMENT: Course modules created by External Sync. Only these can be updated, moved or deleted through the web service, and only by the integration that created them.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module created by the plugin

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the module was created in

FIELD.NAME: integrationid
FIELD.COMMENT: Integration that created the module. NULL means ownership could not be proven, and the module is never changed or deleted through the web service.

TABLE.NAME: local_extsync_question
TABLE.COMMENT: Questions imported by External Sync into a quiz. Replacing an exam's questions only deletes these.

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Question created by the plugin's import

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Quiz the question was imported for

FIELD.NAME: ref
FIELD.COMMENT: The external system's reference for the question: its ID number in the imported document, kept even when Moodle could not store it

FIELD.NAME: integrationid
FIELD.COMMENT: Integration that imported the question. NULL means ownership could not be proven, and the question is never deleted through the web service.

TABLE.NAME: local_extsync_sync
TABLE.COMMENT: Student synchronisations of recent days, so that removals are limited over a period rather than per request.

FIELD.NAME: students
FIELD.COMMENT: Students enrolled with the manual enrolment role before this synchronisation
